description: This file defines the BuzzCommentDecorator class, which provides methods to manipulate and retrieve information about BuzzComment entities, including setting related entities, formatting dates, and managing likes within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: BuzzCommentDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for BuzzComment entity, providing methods to set related entities, format timestamps, and handle likes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a BuzzComment entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the comment based on employee number.

methods.name: setShareById
methods.description: Associates a BuzzShare entity with the comment based on share ID.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the comment in Y-m-d format.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the creation time of the comment in H:i format.

methods.name: isAuthEmployeeLiked
methods.description: Checks if the authenticated employee liked the comment.

methods.name: increaseNumOfLikesByOne
methods.description: Increments the number of likes for the comment by one.

methods.name: decreaseNumOfLikesByOne
methods.description: Decrements the number of likes for the comment by one.
